exercises.question: Which sentence correctly reports a statement?
options: Dijo que estaba cansada. [She said that she was tired.]
Dijo si estaba cansada. [She said if she was tired.]
Preguntó que estaba cansada. [She asked that she was tired.]

exercises.english: She explained that she lived there.

sentences: Primero, ella dijo: «¿Dónde vives?» [First, she said: “Where do you live?”]
Después, yo recordé la pregunta. [Then I remembered the question.]
Finalmente, conté que me preguntó dónde vivía. [Finally, I said that she asked me where I lived.]

exercises.question: Which change is correct?
options: «Estoy aquí» → Dijo que estaba allí. [“I am here” → He said that he was there.]
«Estoy aquí» → Dijo que estoy aquí. [“I am here” → He said that I am here.]
«Estoy aquí» → Dijo que estaré allí. [“I am here” → He said that I would be there.]

exercises.sentence: Él me dijo que no ___ tiempo.
exercises.english: He told me that he did not have time.
The witness asked if someone had called.

exercises.question: Which sentence is reported speech?
options: Explicó que había visto al hombre y preguntó si alguien lo conocía. [He explained that he had seen the man and asked if anyone knew him.]
Vio al hombre caminando por la calle y lo siguió hasta la plaza. [He saw the man walking down the street and followed him to the square.]
El hombre caminaba por la calle cuando vio a la policía. [The man was walking down the street when he saw the police.]
He said that he lived there.
He asked where he lived.
He said that he would live there.
She asked me where I lived.
She told me where she lived.
She asked if I had lived there.

exercises.sentence: El detective preguntó si alguien había llamado a la policía.
exercises.english: The detective asked whether anyone had called the police.

options: Dijo que había visto a un hombre. [He said that he had seen a man.]
Preguntó si había visto. [He asked if he had seen.]
Dijo había visto a un hombre. [He said he had seen a man.]
Preguntó dónde vivía. [She asked where he lived.]
Dijo dónde vivía. [She said where he lived.]
Preguntó que vivía allí. [She asked that he lived there.]
Porque cambia la perspectiva de quien cuenta. [Because the perspective of the person telling it changes.]
Porque cambia el tema de la conversación. [Because the topic of the conversation changes.]
Porque cambia el número de personas. [Because the number of people changes.]

exercises.question: Which sentence best combines reporting, a question and a tense change?
options: Dijo que vivía allí y preguntó si alguien había llegado. [He said that he lived there and asked if someone had arrived.]
Dijo que vivía allí desde hacía varios años con su familia. [He said that he lived there for several years with his family.]
Preguntó a los presentes si alguien había visto al nuevo vecino. [He asked those present if someone had seen the new neighbour.]

template.prompt: Say that he said he was tired and asked if he could go out.
template.answer: Dijo que estaba cansado y preguntó si podía salir.

template.prompt: Write two sentences: the witness explained that he had seen the man; the detective asked him if he knew the man and the witness answered that he did not.
template.answer: El testigo explicó que había visto al hombre. El detective le preguntó si lo conocía y el testigo respondió que no.
